settings.introDetail: Ask Jev questions directly in your Homey Flows. You supply the state and possible answers.
settings.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
settings.keyMissing: Add your TypeSafe API key to get started.
settings.billable: Connection tests and Flow evaluations call TypeSafe and use API credit.
settings.privacy: The app does not read devices or store state, questions or answers. Homey stores your card configuration as part of the Flow.
settings.flowHelp: All Jev cards are under Then. Add a yes/no, choice with 2, 3 or 4 answers, or score card. Fill in state and one question using text or Flow tags. Results are returned as tags in Advanced Flow. Use the yes/no card’s boolean Answer tag in a Logic condition to branch on its result. Describe what each value in state means. Example: "Bas is sleeping: [Asleep]"; insert the Flow tag at [Asleep]. Include units for measurements.
